Honest no-match + broaden (FR-16): the Babolat-under-2000 query returns an EMPTY result set plus broaden = "No Babolat rackets under 2000. Try raising to 3000, or removing the brand." (specific, derived from removable brand+price constraints over current seed). Proven by verify-ai-search.ts case B.

Hybrid keyword fallback with key ABSENT: plain "tennis" and "cricket bat" return sensible non-empty results via the deterministic weighted score with no broaden; the function never errors or hangs without ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Proven by verify-ai-search.ts cases A and D.

Price/brand precision: "cricket bat under 1000" drops the over-budget bat (1500) and returns only items <= 1000; a named brand absent from the catalog yields empty+broaden rather than substituting another brand. Proven by verify-ai-search.ts cases C and E.

Client empty state renders the server broaden string verbatim: SearchResults emptyLabel binds to res.broaden (search.tsx), so the Babolat query shows the specific broaden line, not the generic "Try another search" fallback.

Code-proven in llm.ts (env-gated, AbortController timeout, try/catch fallback); live-provable only once the key is added.
